stem.text: Which list shows electromagnetic waves in order of increasing frequency?

A.text: radio waves $\rightarrow$ gamma rays $\rightarrow$ ultraviolet $\rightarrow$ infra-red

B.text: radio waves $\rightarrow$ infra-red $\rightarrow$ ultraviolet $\rightarrow$ gamma rays

C.text: ultraviolet $\rightarrow$ gamma rays $\rightarrow$ radio waves $\rightarrow$ infra-red

D.text: ultraviolet $\rightarrow$ infra-red $\rightarrow$ radio waves $\rightarrow$ gamma rays
